tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Luca Pacioli was an Italian mathematician, Franciscan friar, and scholar.
  • He is widely regarded as the Father of Accounting for formalizing double-entry bookkeeping.
  • His writings influenced commerce and finance across Europe.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Popularized double-entry bookkeeping
  • Wrote Summa de Arithmetica
  • Influenced modern accounting systems

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content:
• Often associated with the foundations of modern bookkeeping.
  • Worked during the Renaissance period.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• John McCarthy was an American computer scientist.
  • He coined the term Artificial Intelligence.
  • He helped establish AI as a formal academic discipline.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Coined the term AI
  • Created Lisp language
  • Advanced machine intelligence research

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content:
• One of the founding pioneers of AI.
  • Worked at MIT and Stanford.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Al-Khwarizmi was a Persian mathematician and astronomer.
  • He laid foundations for algebra as a systematic discipline.
  • His works influenced mathematics in both East and West.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Founded algebraic methods
  • Popularized Hindu-Arabic numerals
  • Advanced astronomy and geography

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content:
• The word algorithm comes from his name.
  • His book helped shape modern mathematics.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Andreas Vesalius was a pioneering anatomist and physician.
  • He transformed anatomy through direct observation and dissection.
  • He challenged older anatomical errors.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Advanced human anatomical study
  • Published De humani corporis fabrica
  • Modernized medical anatomy

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content:
• Known as a revolutionary figure in medical science.
  • Often called Father of Modern Anatomy as well.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Franz Boas was a pioneering anthropologist.
  • He shaped modern cultural anthropology.
  • He challenged racial and cultural assumptions.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Developed cultural anthropology
  • Promoted fieldwork methods
  • Influenced generations of anthropologists

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content:
• Often called Father of Modern Anthropology.
  • Major critic of scientific racism.

name: Father of Artificial Intelligence : John McCarthy

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• John McCarthy helped establish AI as a scientific field.
  • His work influenced modern machine intelligence.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Frequently cited as the Father of AI.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar was a pioneering astrophysicist.
  • He made profound contributions to stellar evolution.
  • His work shaped modern astrophysics.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Chandrasekhar Limit
  • Stellar structure research
  • Black hole theory contributions

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content:
• Won Nobel Prize in Physics.
  • A major figure in modern astrophysics.

name: Father of Atomic Theory : John Dalton

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• John Dalton was an English chemist and physicist.
  • He proposed one of the earliest scientific atomic theories.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Charaka was an ancient Indian physician and scholar.
  • He is a foundational figure in Ayurveda.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • One of the most influential medical scholars in history.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Robert Koch was a German physician and microbiologist.
  • He established bacteriology as a scientific field.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Koch's postulates
  • Identified major disease-causing bacteria
  • Advanced germ theory

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Won Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

name: Father of Behavioral Economics : Daniel Kahneman

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Daniel Kahneman was a pioneering psychologist and economist.
  • He transformed economics by showing how human decisions are often irrational.
  • His work founded behavioral economics.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content:
• Nobel Prize winner in Economics.
  • Author of Thinking, Fast and Slow.

name: Father of Biodiversity : E. O. Wilson

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Edward O. Wilson was a renowned biologist and naturalist.
  • He popularized biodiversity as a scientific and conservation concept.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Carl Neuberg was a German biochemist.
  • He helped establish biochemistry as an independent discipline.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Aristotle was a Greek philosopher and scientist.
  • He made early systematic studies of living organisms.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Satoshi Nakamoto is the pseudonymous creator associated with Bitcoin.
  • Considered the foundational figure of blockchain technology.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Theophrastus was a Greek scholar and student of Aristotle.
  • He laid the foundations of plant science.

name: Father of C Language : Dennis Ritchie

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Dennis Ritchie was an American computer scientist.
  • He created the C programming language.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Bjarne Stroustrup is a Danish computer scientist.
  • He created the C++ programming language.

name: Father of Calculus : Isaac Newton & Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Newton and Leibniz independently developed calculus.
  • Both are credited as founders of the field.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • One of history’s most famous scientific priority disputes.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• William Harvey was an English physician.
  • He revolutionized understanding of blood circulation.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Antoine Lavoisier was a French chemist who transformed chemistry into a modern science.
  • He emphasized measurement and experimentation.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Law of conservation of mass
  • Modern chemical nomenclature
  • Foundations of modern chemistry

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Often called Father of Modern Chemistry as well.

name: Father of Chess Theory : Wilhelm Steinitz

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Wilhelm Steinitz was the first official world chess champion.
  • He pioneered positional chess strategy.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Widely considered Father of Modern Chess Theory.

name: Father of Classical Physics : Isaac Newton

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • Isaac Newton was a physicist and mathematician whose work shaped classical mechanics.

name: Father of Cloud Computing : J.C.R. Licklider

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• J.C.R. Licklider envisioned globally connected computing systems.
  • His ideas influenced cloud computing and networking.

name: Father of Computer Science : Alan Turing

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Alan Turing laid the foundations of modern computing.
  • His ideas influenced algorithms, computing, and AI.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Also known as a pioneer of AI.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • Charles Babbage designed early programmable computing machines.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • Gifford Pinchot was an American forester and conservationist.

name: Father of Crystallography : William Henry Bragg

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• William Henry Bragg was a pioneering physicist.
  • He helped develop X-ray crystallography.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • Norbert Wiener founded cybernetics as a scientific discipline.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Robert Hooke was an English scientist and inventor.
  • He first used the term cell.

name: Father of Differential Equations : Leonhard Euler

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Leonhard Euler was one of history’s greatest mathematicians.
  • He made enormous contributions to differential equations, calculus, mechanics, and number theory.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Foundations of differential equations
  • Euler’s formulas and methods
  • Advanced mathematical analysis

name: Father of Documentary Film : Robert Flaherty

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Robert Flaherty pioneered documentary filmmaking.
  • He helped establish documentaries as an art form.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Known for the film Nanook of the North.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Ernst Haeckel was a German biologist and naturalist.
  • He helped establish ecology as a scientific field.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Adam Smith was a Scottish economist and philosopher.
  • He laid the foundation of modern economics.

tab2.title: Contributions
tab2.content:
• Wealth of Nations
  • Free market theory
  • Invisible hand concept

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Benjamin Franklin was a scientist, inventor and statesman.
  • He made pioneering studies of electricity.

name: Father of Electromagnetism : James Clerk Maxwell

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • James Clerk Maxwell unified electricity and magnetism into a single theory.

name: Father of Embryology : Karl Ernst von Baer

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Karl Ernst von Baer pioneered embryological studies.
  • He discovered the mammalian ovum.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Thomas Addison was an English physician.
  • He made foundational discoveries in endocrine disorders.

name: Father of Environmental Movement : John Muir

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• John Muir was a naturalist and conservation advocate.
  • He inspired modern environmental activism.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• John Snow was a physician who transformed disease investigation.
  • He is considered a founder of modern epidemiology.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Famous for the Broad Street pump investigation.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Charles Darwin was an English naturalist whose work transformed biology.
  • He developed evolution by natural selection.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • One of the most influential scientists in history.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Dietrich Brandis was a pioneering forester.
  • He helped establish scientific forestry management.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Often called Father of Tropical Forestry too.

name: Father of Game Theory : John von Neumann

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• John von Neumann was a polymath and mathematical genius.
  • He co-founded game theory.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Gregor Mendel was a scientist and monk.
  • His experiments founded genetics.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • James Hutton transformed understanding of Earth's processes.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Euclid was an ancient Greek mathematician.
  • His work shaped geometry for centuries.

name: Father of Graph Theory : Leonhard Euler

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • Euler founded graph theory through groundbreaking mathematical work.

name: Father of Green Revolution : Norman Borlaug

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • Norman Borlaug was an agricultural scientist who helped combat global hunger.

name: Father of Green Revolution (India) : M. S. Swaminathan

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content: • M. S. Swaminathan led India's agricultural transformation.

tab1.title: Biography
tab1.content:
• Marcello Malpighi pioneered microscopic anatomy.
  • He laid foundations of histology.

tab3.title: Facts
tab3.content: • Known as Father of Microscopic Anatomy too.
